itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival at Guwahati
itinerary.description: Once you arrive in Guwahati, our team representative will greet you with a warm welcome at the airport/railway station.After that, you'll be driven to Kaziranga National Park, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The park is home to dense forests, tall elephant grass, and numerous water bodies.Once you reach there, check into your hotel and freshen up. Take some time for relaxation.In the evening, we’ll take you to the Orchid & Biodiversity Park. A perfect photo op is when the sun is setting over the Kaziranga’s marshlands!There’s also an opportunity to enjoy the Assamese cultural dance show, which takes place in the evening.Enjoy an overnight stay in the Kaziranga.

itinerary.title: DAY 2: Kaziranga Elephant & Jeep Safari
itinerary.description: Get up early in the morning and go out for an exciting Elephant Safari in the park. You’ll get a chance to spot the rhinos, swamp deer, and elephants. Also, the park is home to over 70% of the world’s one-horned rhino population!After your safari session, return to your hotel for a delicious breakfast.In the afternoon, we again set out for a safari. However, this time we’ll go on a jeep safari, where you can find animals like royal Bengal tigers, hog deer, wild elephants, and more.Have a leisurely evening. You can utilise this time to either rest or explore the park on your own.Take a restful night of sleep at Kaziranga.Important Note:Elephant rides are all regulated and controlled by the Forest Department of the Govt. of Assam and are subject to availability only.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 3: Transfer to Bomdila (230 km / 7 hrs) – Trip to Gontse Rabgyaling Monastery
itinerary.description: Have a hearty breakfast in the morning.Now, we’ll leave the park and move towards Bomdila. This charming town is famous for its hand-woven carpets. The drive is quite long – 7 hours. However, the journey is quite scenic. Capture the lifelong pictures of lush tea gardens and river valleys as you pass them.We’ll also make a stop-off at Tipi Orchidarium along the way. This institute houses over 500 orchid species!Once you reach there, we’ll visit the peaceful Gontse Rabgyaling Monastery.Check into your hotel and enjoy an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 4: Transfer to Tawang (180 km / 7 hrs)
itinerary.description: Have breakfast in the morning.Now you’ll be transferred to Tawang. The 7-hour journey is quite scenic as you pass through snow-capped landscapes and strategic mountain passes.Along the way, we’ll be making a stopover at Sela Pass (13,700 ft), which stays covered in snow for a good part of the year. Capture patriotic moments with your camera as the flag flutters with the wind.We’ll also be making a stop at the Sela Lake and Jaswantgarh War Memorial!If time permits, we’ll also visit the hidden gem of Arunachal Pradesh, the beautiful Nuranang (Jung) Falls.Once you get to Tawang, check into your hotel and get a restful night of sleep.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 5: Sightseeing in Tawang
itinerary.description: Have a delicious breakfast and then get ready for a sightseeing tour of Tawang today!We’ll be visiting the following tourist attractions:Tawang Monastery– This is India’s largest and the world’s second-largest Buddhist monasteryUrgelling Monastery– Welcome to the birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama!Ani Gompa– This serene Buddhist nunnery offers a very peaceful environment for meditationBuddha Park– Capture the photos of the majestic golden statue of Lord Buddha hereTawang Craft Centre– Get acquainted with the traditional Monpa handicrafts, like woollen carpets, wood carvings, masks, etc.War Memorial– Pay tribute to the martyred soldiers of the 1962 Indo-China WarIn the evening, enjoy an exciting Light & Sound Show at Tawang War Memorial. Also, take some time out to stroll in the local markets and shop for souvenirs.Return to your hotel and get a restful night of sleep.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 6: Bumla Pass (37 km) – Madhuri Lake
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast at your hotel.Thereafter, you’ll be taken on a full-day sightseeing tour of Bumla Pass. The drive is just 37 km and can be covered in under an hour. Located at an altitude of 16,000 ft, it is a must-visit spot for adventure lovers!From here, you can watch the Indo-China border being manned by the Indian soldiers. Photo ops galore!On the return journey, we’ll make a stop at the Pankang Teng Tso Lake (PT Tso). Enjoy the beautiful scenery of pine forests and snow! Do engage in a little photography session here, as it’ll be worthwhile.Next, you’ll be taken to the Shonga-tser Lake, which is also known as the Madhuri Lake. And yes, it’s named after the Bollywood actress Madhuri Dixit, after she shot a song for the movie Koyla here. Originally, the lake was formed from an earthquake in 1971. Do take the photo shots of reflection in this beautiful lake.In the evening, we’ll drive you back towards Tawang.Also, you can enjoy the Light & Sound Show at the Tawang War Memorial, the tickets for which you have to arrange on your own. The show beautifully portrays the valour of Indian soldiers during the 1962 war with China.Return to your hotel at Tawang for an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 7: Tawang to Dirang Transfer (140 km / 4.5 hrs)
itinerary.description: Have breakfast and then check out of your hotel.Now, you’ll be driven to Dirang, the journey of which will take less than 5 hours. It’s famous for having miraculous hot water springs, which are believed to cure skin ailments.Enjoy the scenic journey filled with picturesque landscapes, quaint villages, and cultural sites.Along the way, we’ll be making a stop at the TDL Monastery.Once you reach Dirang, check into your hotel and take a restful night of sleep.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 8: Transfer to Guwahati (300 km / 10 hrs)
itinerary.description: Wake up early in the morning, and drive back towards Guwahati via Kalaktang. This 10-hour drive is quite long but also scenic.Capture the beautiful picture of lush valleys and farms as you pass them.Once you reach there, check into your hotel and get a restful night of sleep.

itinerary.title: DAY 9: Transfer to Cherrapunji (150 km / 4 hrs) and Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Have breakfast in the morning.And now you’ll be taken on a sightseeing trip to Cherrapunji, the wettest place on Earth! It’s a quintessential paradise for nature lovers and explorers.Explore the natural falls, like Elephant Falls, Nohkalikai Falls, and Seven Sisters Falls. Don’t forget to capture their timeless beauty with your camera!You’ll also be taken to the following places:Mawkdok Dympep ValleyMawsmai CavesEco ParkAfter a tiring yet fulfilling sightseeing trip, return to your hotel and get some sleep.Note:Accommodations here are basic three-star hotels. Don’t expect too many modern amenities.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 10: Transfer to Mawlynnong (81 km / 2.5 hrs) – Dawki (31 km / 1.5 hrs)
itinerary.description: Take a nourishing meal in the morning. Afterwards, you’ll be taken on a tour of Meghalaya. In particular, you’ll be visiting:Mawlynnong Village– This is Asia’s cleanest village!Living Root Bridge– Get inspired by the locals’ ingenious craftsmanshipLater, we’ll be visiting Dawki, where you can enjoy a thrilling boat ride on the crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River. The river is so clear and transparent that the tourists say that they feel like flying in the air.Come back to your hotel in Shillong and enjoy an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 11: Shillong to Guwahati Transfer (100 km / 2.5 hrs) and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast at the hotel in the morning.On this last day of your tour, the first half will be spent sightseeing. You’ll be taken to the following places:Ward's LakeShillong CathedralUmiam LakeLady Hydari ParkAfter that, you’ll be dropped off at the Guwahati airport or railway station, as per your choice. Hope you have a great trip!Note:Lady Hydari Park is closed on Mondays.Places You’ll See

12-jyotirlinga-tour-package.overview:
There are countless temples in India. However, Jyotirlingas hold a place of their own! Deemed as the ultimate pilgrimage, See More

the trip to these holy temples is considered highly sacred for it promises Moksha – liberation from the cycle of birth and death! The Jyotirlingas are distributed across the country – from Somnath in Gujarat to Rameshwaram in Tamil Nadu! Although this is a challenging journey, our 12 Jyotirlinga Tour Package takes you to all these special shrines of Lord Shiva across the entire nation.
So think no more! Book this package now, and be the recipient of the abundant blessings that will fall your way once you complete this trip. To get a quote and know more, simply give us a call and we’ll get back to you shortly!
Why Visit the 12 Jyotirlingas?
The 12 Jyotirlingas are considered highly sacred, and visiting them is a must for every Lord Shiva devotee. It’s believed that these temples manifest from the very energy of him when he was in the form of an infinite cosmic light pillar.
As per the Shiva Purana, once Lord Shiva appeared in the form of this bright light in order to exert his supremacy over Lord Vishnu and Lord Brahma. And now, each Jyotirlinga is a representation of his divine energy, and is considered to be a self-manifested lingam! Also, it’s believed that taking this sacred spiritual tour of Lord Shiva temples cleanses one’s sins and grants them Moksha, in turn.
Moreover, if you go to these holy temples, you can enjoy the culture and traditions of different places that you get to visit while being on this holy journey. Also, many devotees combine this trip with other tours such as Char Dham Yatra or Shaktipeeth visits, to make this a truly mega pilgrimage!
Book My Quick Trippers’s Jyotirlinga Darshan package and take an easy-peasy comfortable trip to India's most sacred shrines!
Significance of 12 Jyotirlingas
Here’s a quick guide to all twelve shrines covered in the 12 Jyotirlinga Tour Package:

Somnath: This was one of the very first Jyotirlingas! This sea-facing temple symbolizes eternal faith. Devotes simply love the evening light and sound show here.
Mallikarjuna: Also known as the “Kailash of the South”, this temple is associated with Parvati as Mallika and Shiva as Arjuna.
Mahakaleshwar: This is the only south-facing Jyotirlinga you’ll find. It’s famous for its holy Bhasma Aarti, where Lord Shiva is offered the sacred ash.
Omkareshwar: The specialty of this Jyotirlinga is that it is located on an island that is shaped like the OM symbol. It’s believed that coming here fulfills your wishes.
Kedarnath: This temple has a huge significance associated with it. Not only is it a Jyotirlinga, it’s also a part of the Chhota Dham circuit. It’s also the highest Jyotirlinga in altitude.
Bhimashankar: Surrounded by dense forests, this temple is linked to the mythology about the demon Tripurasura being defeated by Lord Shiva.
Kashi Vishwanath: Located in the ‘spiritual capital of India’, Varanasi, this temple promises Moksha if someone dies here of natural causes.
Trimbakeshwar: This is a unique Jyotirlinga that has 3 lingams, representing Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva. This temple is popular for its Narayan Nagbali Puja rituals.
Vaidyanath: This temple sees a load of pilgrim traffic in the Shravan month, that is, when Kanwariyas visit this temple. Lord Shiva is worshipped here as the supreme healer, a Vaidya that is.
Nageshwar: This Jyotirlinga houses a tall Shiva statue, and it’s associated with the demon Daruka.
Ramanathaswamy: This temple has a very old Ramayana link. It’s believed that Lord Rama worshipped Lord Shiva here before he went to the Lanka war. There are also 22 sacred wells inside the temple where one can take a ritual bath.
Grishneshwar: This is the smallest Jyotirlinga, located very close to the Ajanta-Ellora caves. You can enjoy the rich carvings on temple walls here and the ever-present peaceful atmosphere.

To enjoy a smooth trip, simply opt for our Jyotirlinga Yatra booking and travel in comfort!
12 Jyotirlinga Tour Package by Train and Flight
My Quick Trippers also offers you combo 12 Jyotirlinga Tour Packages by Train and Flight, where you get to travel by both railways and plane. This combined trip makes the journey easier and far smoother. With the comfort & high speed of air travel, along with the traditional experience of the train journey, you get to enjoy the best of both worlds.
On this hybrid route, we would cover segments like Mumbai to Madurai and Hyderabad to Deoghar by flight. This is the most suitable way, as these are located far from each other and flying there considerably reduces the travel time. And for the shorter segments like Omkareshwar to Ujjain or Nashik to Bhimashankar, we can go for the scenic train journey. 
With this train and flight Jyotirlinga Yatra package, devotees reach the Jyotirlingas in the most optimal time and also reduce fatigue. In general, this fight and train to Jyotirlingas tour is the best way to complete Darshan of all 12 Jyotirlingas (takes about 12-18 days). Book now or call us to know more about this combo package! 
Best Time for the 12 Jyotirlinga Tour
The best time to go on this sacred Jyotirlinga tour differs from region to region, as the sacred shrines are distributed all across India. However, for most shrines, you can consider the season of autumn (September – November) for taking this sacred tour. The weather in this window is pleasant for the most part, and therefore can be considered for the holy trip.
Moreover, this is also ideal for the tour to Kedarnath, which gets closed in November, and stays so until April. Also, this window is great for visiting the temple in the south (Rameswaram and Srisailam) as well.
Travel Tips for Devotees
Here is some travel advice that you might find useful on this Jyotirlinga Yatra Package:

Even before you step out for this sacred tour, make a Sankalp in front of Lord Shiva’s idol in your home or a nearby temple, asking for the success of this tour.
Book your 12 Jyotirlinga Travel Package in advance – at least 3-6 months. The slots get quickly filled up, especially if you’re planning to travel during special occasions, such as Shravan, Navratri, and Maha Shivaratri.
If you’re a senior citizen, then consider going by train or plane, as this will help you reduce the physical strain and exhaustion caused by road travel.
If you plan to take the helicopter services, then make sure you have your ID proof and medical certificate ready.
Try to make your trip even more fulfilling by combining your Jyotirlinga tour with nearby major sightseeing attractions, like Dwarkadhish Temple (in Dwarka), Ellora Caves (in Aurangabad), and Rameswaram beaches (in Rameswaram).
Try to group your Jyotirlinga tour in a region-wise cluster. For example, combine your temple trips in West India, South India, Central India, and North India. This organised tour will help you save time and reduce your fatigue significantly.
There’s always a chance of delays. This could be due to weather and other unforeseeable factors. Therefore, always keep 1-2 days spare in your Jyotirlinga Yatra itinerary.
Throughout your trip, stay hydrated. Always carry a water bottle with you. Also, eat easily digestible, light food to aid digestion.
Always follow the temple etiquette. Some common practices include removing your shoes before entering the temple, wearing modest clothes, and not carrying leather items inside the shrine.

12 Jyotirlinga Route Map
The Jyotirlinga are spread all across the nation, and that is why it’s best to cover them in clusters. That is, if you’re in the west India, it’s best to visit all the temples in this region first, before moving on to the other region. Here’s a Jyotirlinga Route Map for your guidance:

Gujarat (Nageshwar → Somnath)
Madhya Pradesh (Omkareshwar → Mahakaleshwar)
North India (Kashi Vishwanath → Vaidyanath → Kedarnath)
Maharashtra (Trimbakeshwar → Bhimashankar → Grishneshwar)
South India (Mallikarjuna → Rameswaram)

itinerary.title: Day 1: : Arrival in Mumbai and Journey to Rajkot
itinerary.description:
Once you reach Mumbai, our travel representatives will greet you with a warm welcome.
Now, it’s time to catch the overnight train to Rajkot, Gujarat. You’ll get full assistance in boarding from our side.
Enjoy an overnight stay on the train. We recommend packing some light snacks and water for this train journey.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Trip to Dwarkadhish and Nageshwar Jyotirlinga
itinerary.description:
By early morning, you’ll arrive in Rajkot.
Deboard the train, and now you’ll be driven to Dwarka. This holy city is one of the Char Dhams and also a Sapta Puri.
Now, check into your pre-booked hotel and freshen up!
Later, you’ll be taken to the Dwarkadhish Temple first. It is dedicated to Lord Krishna, where he’s worshipped in his royal form as the King of Dwarka!
Next, you’ll be driven to the very first Jyotirlinga of this tour, that is, Nageshwar Jyotirlinga. Lord Shiva is worshipped here as the protector against poison.
After your Darshan and Poojan, return to your hotel for dinner in the evening.
Get a restful night of sleep at your hotel.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 3 – Somnath Jyotirlinga Darshan
itinerary.description:
Have breakfast and then check out of your hotel.
Now, you’ll be transferred to Somnath near Veraval. Once you arrive in this city, check into your hotel and take rest for a while.
Afterwards, you'll be taken to Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple, a shrine that enjoys a glorious history. According to the Hindu mythology, it’s believed that the temple was originally built by Chandra Dev in order to please Lord Shiva. Over centuries, this temple has been destroyed and rebuilt 17 times, and now stands as a metaphorical symbol of faith and resilience!
Also, attend the evening Aarti at the temple.
Then, come back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 4 – Somnath to Ujjain transfer (Overnight Train Journey)
itinerary.description:
Wake up early and attend the morning Aarti at Somnath temple.
Now, check out of your hotel and head to the railway station and catch a train to Ujjain in Madhya Pradesh.
This will be an overnight journey by train. We recommend carrying a light shawl or blanket with you as the nights can get a little chilly.

itinerary.title: Day 5 – Arrival in Ujjain and Visit to Omkareshwar Temple
itinerary.description:
You’ll arrive in Ujjain early in the morning. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and take a little rest for a while.
Now, you’ll be taken to the Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga, which is situated on an island surrounded by the Narmada River. There’s another specialty of this island, which is that it is shaped like an ‘OM’ symbol. You can also choose to circumambulate the island, as many devotees do.
Afterwards, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 6 – Ujjain (Mahakaleshwar Darshan) and Train to Haridwar
itinerary.description:
Get up early in the morning and proceed for the Darshan and Poojan at the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga. This is one of the most revered shrines of Lord Shiv, where he’s worshiped as the destroyer of time itself.
If you reach there early, you can also witness the Bhasma Aarti, which takes place from 4 AM to 6 AM. In this sacred ritual, Lord Shiva is offered the sacred ash.
Later, enjoy a trip to the popular temples like Harsiddhi Mata Temple and Kal Bhairav Temple. Both of these temples have a strong background in the rich Tantric traditions of India.
In the evening, you’ll be driven to the railway station, where you’ll board the train to Haridwar.
Enjoy an overnight stay on the train.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 7 – Arrival in Haridwar (Ganga Aarti Experience)
itinerary.description:
You’ll reach Haridwar in the morning. From the railway station, you'll be transferred to your hotel, where you can check in. Take some time to relax and freshen up. The rest of the day is free!
In the evening, drop by the Har ki Pauri and witness the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti. Watch as the thousands of Diyas float by on the Ganga River.
Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 8 – Transfer to Guptkashi and Visit to Ardhanarishvara Temple
itinerary.description:
Have breakfast in the morning.
Now, begin a scenic drive towards Guptkashi. Once you get there, check into your pre-booked hotel.
Now, you’ll be taken to the Ardhanarishvara Temple. This temple holds a great deal of significance as it symbolizes Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati’s unity.
Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 9 – Trek to Kedarnath Temple
itinerary.description:
In the morning, we’ll depart from Sonprayag to start the trek to the Kedarnath temple.
Begin your 16 km trek via Gaurikund. You can also hire a pony/Palki service to reach the Kedarnath Dham.
Once you reach the temple, engage in the Darshan and Poojan ritual. The views all around are gorgeous, providing you with a backdrop of snow-capped peaks.
Wait till the sun goes down, when you can attend the evening Aarti, which is a soul-stirring experience, to say the least.
Your dinner and overnight stay will be arranged in Kedarnath only.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 10 – Morning Aarti at Kedarnath and Transfer to Rudraprayag
itinerary.description:
Wake up early before sunrise and attend the morning Aarti at Kedarnath temple.
Now trek back to Sonprayag. From there, you’ll be taken to Rudraprayag.
Check into your hotel there and enjoy an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 11 – Overnight Train to Varanasi
itinerary.description:
Have a hearty breakfast.
Now, you’ll be driven back to Haridwar.
Once you reach there, board the overnight train for Varanasi. Your lunch and dinner will be served on the train itself.

itinerary.title: Day 12 – Evening Ganga Aarti at Varanasi
itinerary.description:
Welcome to Varanasi! This is one of the world’s oldest cities, and is quite dear to Lord Shiva.
Now check into your hotel and rest for a while.
Visit the Dasaswamedh Ghat in the evening, where you can witness the grand Ganga Aarti live. Take in the whole experience of chants, bells, and floating lamps!
Come back to your hotel in the evening for an overnight stay.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 13 – Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga and Transfer to Deoghar
itinerary.description:
Wake up early to go for a morning Darshan at the Kashi Vishwanath Jyotirlinga. Perform Poojan to your heart’s content.
Next, we’ll take you to the Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple.
After that, board a train to Jasidih. Once you get there, you’ll take a short drive towards Deoghar, Jharkhand.
Enjoy an overnight stay in your hotel at Deoghar.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 14 – Baba Baidyanath Jyotirlinga and Train to Chennai
itinerary.description:
Wake up early in the morning and get ready for Darshan at the Baba Baidyanath Jyotirlinga. This temple is special since here Lord Shiva is worshipped as a healer (Vaidya).
Perform your Abhishek Puja & Darshan and soak in the calming atmosphere of the shrine. It is believed that Ravana himself worshipped Lord Shiva here by offering his heads as a sacrifice.
Next, board a train to Kolkata from here. Once you reach Howrah station, take a connecting train to Chennai.
Enjoy an overnight stay on the train.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 15 – Arrival in Chennai and Train to Rameswaram
itinerary.description:
You’ll arrive in Chennai in the morning.
Take some time to freshen up and relax in the station waiting room.
Later, board the train to Rameswaram, one of the most holy pilgrimage towns in India!
Enjoy an overnight stay on the train.

itinerary.title: Day 16 – Arrival at Rameswaram (Leisure Day)
itinerary.description:
Once you reach Rameswaram, get to your hotel and check in.
The rest of the day is purposefully made free of any sightseeing. You can take this leisure time to rest or travel on your own around the area. If you go out, do indulge in the local Tamil vegetarian cuisine, which is simply delicious.
At night, enjoy dinner and get a restful night of sleep.

itinerary.title: Day 17 – Rameswaram Darshan and Drive to Madurai
itinerary.description:
We’ll visit the Ramanathaswamy Temple early in the morning. This temple houses the very Rameshwaram Jyotirlinga that Lord Rama worshipped after he went to war with Ravana.
Afterwards, you’ll be taken for a drive to Madurai.
In the evening, visit the majestic Meenakshi Amman Temple, which is dedicated to Goddess Parvati. Enjoy the masterpiece of Dravidian architecture that this temple is!
Spend the night in your Madurai hotel.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 18 – Train to Pune
itinerary.description:
Treat yourself to a delicious breakfast.
Now, you’ll be transferred to Madurai railway station, where you can board the train to Pune.
Enjoy an overnight journey on the train.

itinerary.title: Day 19 – Arrival at Pune (Leisure Day)
itinerary.description:
Once you arrive in Pune, check into your hotel.
The rest of the day is free. You can utilize it by either resting or going sightseeing/shopping on your own.
Enjoy the overnight stay at your hotel in Pune.

itinerary.title: Day 20 – Visit to Bhimashankar and Trimbakeshwar
itinerary.description:
Have breakfast and then get ready for the Jyotirlinga tour.
Today, you’ll be taken to the Bhimashankar Temple, which is located in the lush Sahyadri Hills. It's also considered to be the source of the river Bhima.
In the latter part of the day, we’ll visit yet another Jyotirlinga, that is Trimbakeshwar Temple, which is located in Nashik.
At night, return to the hotel and get a restful night of sleep.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 21 – Trimbakeshwar Darshan, Nashik Sightseeing, and Trip to Shirdi
itinerary.description:
In the morning, set out again for the Darshan at the Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga.
Afterwards, you’ll indulge in a sightseeing tour of Nashik, where you’ll be visiting:
Sita Gufa (This is where Sita stayed during exile)
Kapileshwar Temple
Kala Ram Temple
Panchavati and Godavari River
Later in the day, drive towards Shirdi and check into your hotel for an overnight stay.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 22 – Shirdi Sai Baba Darshan
itinerary.description:

Ayodhya is a sacred abode of Lord Rama, Maryada Purushottam. itinerary.title: Day 1: Arriving in Ayodhya - Feel the divine presence of Lord Rama
itinerary.description:
On the first day, our tour representative will pick you up from your designated location (station/airport) and transfer you to your pre-booked hotel. After some relaxation, you will enjoy a guided Ayodhya Tour. We will explore the following places-
Ram Janmabhoomi-
Ram Janmabhoomi is a landmark temple as it is the birthplace of Lord Rama. devotees from all across the world visit here to get the divine blessings of Lord Rama. After a long held wait of many years, the sacred consecration of the temple took place on Jan22nd 2024.
Kanak Bhawan Temple-
Kanak Bhavan has kept the stories of Treta Yuga. This sacred temple was a gift to Lord Rama and Goddess Sita just after their wedding by Kaikeyi. It used to be their personal residence.
Dashrath Mahal -
It is a popular Siddha Peetha, and divine abode of King Dasharatha, (father of Lord Rama). You will see the beautiful idols of Lord Rama, Devi Sita, Lakshman, Shatrughan and Bharat here.
Hanuman Garhi-
Hanuman Garhi is dedicated to Lord Hanuman who is considered as a protector of Ayodhya. It is said that Lord Hanuman resides in a cave and watches over the entire city of Ayodhya to protect them from all the evils.
Evening Tour-
Embracing Bhakti, culture and peace wholeheartedly
The divine Aarti at Saryu River in Naya Ghat is something which will take your breath away.
Witness the living spiritual heritage of Ayodhya as you stroll along the serene Saryu River Ghats.
Overnight stay-
After the sightseeing Ayodhya Tour with your loved ones, the day ends on a happy note. We will return to our hotel room for an overnight stay.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 2: Cultural and spiritual escape in the city of Legends
itinerary.description:
After breakfast in the morning, we will explore the Saryu River to take a holy dip for spiritual purification and enjoy a scenic boat ride.
We will also witness the sacred
Ram ki Paidi-
It's a beautiful series of Ghats built on the banks of the Saryu River. It’s a place where devotees take holy dip to dissolve their sins.
Nageshwarnath Temple-
It is a must not miss place when you are on Ayodhya Tour. We will visit here for sure. It’s a temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, built by Kush ( son of Lord Rama).
If time allows, we will explore,
Valmiki Ramayana Bhawan–
The sacred Bhawan is dedicated to Sage Valmiki (Creator of Ramayana). Its lush greenery and peaceful vibe are a perfect spot for meditation and relaxation.
Treta Ke Thakur-
Treta Ke Thakur is a very popular sacred spot in Ayodhya. It’s the same place where Lord Rama performed Ashwamedha Yagya. There are many statues in this temple made of Blackstone and belonging to the era of Vikramaditya.
Evening-
Ayodhya is a place where you will discover your soul and be nourished by the eternal heritage of faith. After sightseeing, we will depart from Ayodhya with the divine blessings of Lord Rama, Mata Sita and Lord Hanuman. We will drop you at your selected location and the trip to Ayodhya will end on a happy note.
Places You’ll See

This is one of the best selfie spots where you can make some amazing reels and expand your social media follower list.
Moreover, this city is home to 68 Teerths (holding high religious significance) and has a cluster of 108 Shivlingas, making it a must-visit Shiva site. You should also visit the ancient Mamleshwar temple, established beautifully on the left bank of the Narmada. Furthermore, don’t forget to make a visit to the Statue of Oneness (dedicated to Adi Shankaracharya). It is believed that the sacred inscriptions on the temple walls are dated to 1063 AD. Maharani Ahilyabai Holkar was known to be devoted and a patron of architecture, and gave her patronage to this temple, now a protected monument by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI). Pay a visit to the temple, then take on the Narmada Parikrama, a sacred circular route around Omkar Hill, which is around 7 km.
Apart from this, the path that runs along the parikrama route is filled with many ancient temples, peaceful ashrams, and the meeting of two rivers, hence making the route quite beautiful and spiritual. Here is a detailed guide to help you plan your journey:Get up early in the morning, and first visit the Taj Mahal in the daylight – one of the most known and admired symbols of eternal love and beauty in the world. Spend a few hours in this marvelous marble tomb and reflect on the grandeur of its architecture and the immaculate gardens.Next, visit the Agra fort, which is just a few miles from Taj Mahal. The Agra Fort, which is on the UNESCO world heritage site list, is a must visit location. Drop in on the great red sandstone fortress, which was the place where the Mughal rulers used to stay.Midday:Go for the simple option and have lunch in a preferred Local restaurant. Make up your mind between Mughlai cuisine and all other regional specialties.Afternoon:Head to Mehtab Bagh — a beautifully landscaped garden complex located across the Yamuna River, directly opposite the Taj Mahal. Enjoy a calm, picturesque view of the monument from this serene spot and witness its stunning reflection during sunset.Evening:First, walk around Ram Bagh, the oldest Mughal garden in India, then visit Chini Ka Rauza, which is known for its delicate Persian style.You can also visit Firozabad and Sikandra with a visit to their places of interest like historic monuments and markets.At the end of the day, think about the beauty and the history you've seen and you take a bus or taxi to your accommodation or departure point.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival at Aurangabad
itinerary.description:
Upon your arrival in Aurangabad, you’ll be greeted by our team representative at Airport/Railway station.
You’ll be taken to your pre-booked hotel.
Relax for a while, then enjoy a sightseeing tour in Aurangabad, consisting of Bibi Ka Maqbara, Daulatabad Fort, and Aurangabad Caves.
Enjoy the overnight stay at the hotel.
Aurangabad:
The city of Aurangabad was founded in 1610, on the site of a village, Khirki by Malik Ambar - the Prime Minister of Murtaza Nizam Shah II. When Fateh Khan, Malik Ambar's son turned successor in 1626, he gave the city the name 'Fatehpur'.
Aurangabad today is a bustling city of Maharashtra with diverse big and small industries, fine silken textiles, and exquisite hand woven brocades of silver and gold fabrics, Himroo of the world fame.
To scholars and lovers of art and culture the city is more familiar as the gateway to the ancient caves of Ajanta and Ellora, both famous as treasure houses of Indian Art and Sculpture.
Aurangabad Caves:
The almost forgotten caves of Aurangabad lie just outside the city. Excavated between the 2nd and 6th century AD, they reflect TANTRIC influences in their iconography and architectural designs. In all there are nine caves which are mainly Viharas (monasteries).
Overnight stay at the hotel.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 2: Aurangabad Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description:
Have a hearty breakfast and then get ready for a sightseeing tour!
Visit Ajanta Caves & Ellora Caves.
Return to the hotel for an overnight stay.
Ajanta caves:
Nestling in an inner fold of the Sahyadri hills, 100 km from Aurangabad in the shape of a mammoth horse- shoe, are the 30 rock-hewn caves of Ajanta. The Caves date from the 2nd century BC. Discovered in 1819 by a group of British army officers, these startling achievements took around 600 years to create.
Carved with little more than a hammer and chisel, Ajanta, once the retreat of Buddhist monastic orders features several 'Chaityas' (chapels) and 'Viharas' (monasteries). Return to Aurangabad and overnight will be at Aurangabad.
Ellora Caves:
Impressive in their own right are the rock-hewn temples and monasteries of Ellora that lie just 30 km away from Aurangabad city. In all, there are 34 cave temples, 12 Mahayana Buddhist caves (550-750 AD), 17 Hindu caves (600-875 AD), and 5 caves of the Jain faith (800-1000 AD). Kailas Temple (cave16), the central attraction at Ellora, is the most remarkable.
If time permits - then visit the Bhadra Maruti Temple (only temple where Lord Hanuman is seen in a sleeping posture).
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival Srinagar (300 kms / 10 hrs)
itinerary.description: Welcome to Srinagar/Jammu, You are greeted on arrival at Srinagar Airport/ Jammu Railway Station by My Quick Trippers representative and Transfer to Srinagar, on arrival check inn at Hotel, Overnight stay at Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Srinagar Sonamarg - Baltal (90 kms / 3 hrs)
itinerary.description: Morning after Breakfast transfer to Sonmarg known as ‘Meadow of Gold’ on the valley of River Sindhu. View magnificent picturesque mountain ranges, overnight stay at Tents in Baltal.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Baltal - Holy Cave - Baltal
itinerary.description:
Early morning proceed to Amarnath Caves or to helipad. (Helicopter Services is subject to weather conditions). Helicopter operates till Panchtarni, It is about 6kms from pantarni to holy cave. You can reach to the cave by pony/palki (yours cost) or by walk. After Darshan return in time to Helipad to take back Helicopter to Baltal. Overnight in Baltal, In case of late, you can stay in Panctarni at own cost.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 4: Sonamarg - Srinagar
itinerary.description:
Morning proceed to Srinagar for local sightseeing at Srinagar which includes Mughal Gardens, Nishat Bagh, Cheshma Shahi (The Royal Spring) built by Shah Jahan in 1636 AD, Nishat Bagh (The Garden of Pleasure) laid out by Jahangir for his beloved Noor Jahan in 1632 AD. Round off the trip with a visit to the Oriental Kashmir Carpet factory and Shankaracharya temple, Dinner & overnight stay in houseboat/Hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 5: Srinagar - Gulmarg - Srinagar
itinerary.description:
After breakfast drive to Gulmarg, also known as the ‘Meadow of Flowers’. Enjoy a fun-filled pony ride and gondola rides (on direct payment), Gulmarg is primarily famous for its golf course with 18 holes and has one of the best ski slopes in the world, later drive back to Srinagar. Dinner &overnight stay at Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Day 6: Srinagar - Katra 300 Kms/ 10 Hrs.
itinerary.description: Morning after breakfast drive to Katra, the journey will take you through breath talking mountains, forests covered with pine trees and Asia’s longest Tunnel (Jawahar Tunnel) on arrival check inn at Hotel, overnight stay at hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 9: Amritsar Departure

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival at Guwahati
itinerary.description: Once you arrive in Guwahati, our team representative will greet you with a warm welcome at the airport/railway station.After that, you'll be driven to Kaziranga National Park, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The park is home to dense forests, tall elephant grass, and numerous water bodies.Once you reach there, check into your hotel and freshen up. Take some time for relaxation.In the evening, we’ll take you to the Orchid & Biodiversity Park. A perfect photo op is when the sun is setting over the Kaziranga’s marshlands!There’s also an opportunity to enjoy the Assamese cultural dance show, which takes place in the evening.Enjoy an overnight stay in the Kaziranga.

itinerary.title: DAY 2: Kaziranga Elephant & Jeep Safari
itinerary.description: Get up early in the morning and go out for an exciting Elephant Safari in the park. You’ll get a chance to spot the rhinos, swamp deer, and elephants. Also, the park is home to over 70% of the world’s one-horned rhino population!After your safari session, return to your hotel for a delicious breakfast.In the afternoon, we again set out for a safari. However, this time we’ll go on a jeep safari, where you can find animals like royal Bengal tigers, hog deer, wild elephants, and more.Have a leisurely evening. You can utilise this time to either rest or explore the park on your own.Take a restful night of sleep at Kaziranga.Important Note:Elephant rides are all regulated and controlled by the Forest Department of the Govt. of Assam and are subject to availability only.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 3: Transfer to Bomdila (230 km / 7 hrs) – Trip to Gontse Rabgyaling Monastery
itinerary.description: Have a hearty breakfast in the morning.Now, we’ll leave the park and move towards Bomdila. This charming town is famous for its hand-woven carpets. The drive is quite long – 7 hours. However, the journey is quite scenic. Capture the lifelong pictures of lush tea gardens and river valleys as you pass them.We’ll also make a stop-off at Tipi Orchidarium along the way. This institute houses over 500 orchid species!Once you reach there, we’ll visit the peaceful Gontse Rabgyaling Monastery.Check into your hotel and enjoy an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 4: Transfer to Tawang (180 km / 7 hrs)
itinerary.description: Have breakfast in the morning.Now you’ll be transferred to Tawang. The 7-hour journey is quite scenic as you pass through snow-capped landscapes and strategic mountain passes.Along the way, we’ll be making a stopover at Sela Pass (13,700 ft), which stays covered in snow for a good part of the year. Capture patriotic moments with your camera as the flag flutters with the wind.We’ll also be making a stop at the Sela Lake and Jaswantgarh War Memorial!If time permits, we’ll also visit the hidden gem of Arunachal Pradesh, the beautiful Nuranang (Jung) Falls.Once you get to Tawang, check into your hotel and get a restful night of sleep.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 5: Sightseeing in Tawang
itinerary.description: Have a delicious breakfast and then get ready for a sightseeing tour of Tawang today!We’ll be visiting the following tourist attractions:Tawang Monastery– This is India’s largest and the world’s second-largest Buddhist monasteryUrgelling Monastery– Welcome to the birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama!Ani Gompa– This serene Buddhist nunnery offers a very peaceful environment for meditationBuddha Park– Capture the photos of the majestic golden statue of Lord Buddha hereTawang Craft Centre– Get acquainted with the traditional Monpa handicrafts, like woollen carpets, wood carvings, masks, etc.War Memorial– Pay tribute to the martyred soldiers of the 1962 Indo-China WarIn the evening, enjoy an exciting Light & Sound Show at Tawang War Memorial. Also, take some time out to stroll in the local markets and shop for souvenirs.Return to your hotel and get a restful night of sleep.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 6: Bumla Pass (37 km) – Madhuri Lake
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast at your hotel.Thereafter, you’ll be taken on a full-day sightseeing tour of Bumla Pass. The drive is just 37 km and can be covered in under an hour. Located at an altitude of 16,000 ft, it is a must-visit spot for adventure lovers!From here, you can watch the Indo-China border being manned by the Indian soldiers. Photo ops galore!On the return journey, we’ll make a stop at the Pankang Teng Tso Lake (PT Tso). Enjoy the beautiful scenery of pine forests and snow! Do engage in a little photography session here, as it’ll be worthwhile.Next, you’ll be taken to the Shonga-tser Lake, which is also known as the Madhuri Lake. And yes, it’s named after the Bollywood actress Madhuri Dixit, after she shot a song for the movie Koyla here. Originally, the lake was formed from an earthquake in 1971. Do take the photo shots of reflection in this beautiful lake.In the evening, we’ll drive you back towards Tawang.Also, you can enjoy the Light & Sound Show at the Tawang War Memorial, the tickets for which you have to arrange on your own. The show beautifully portrays the valour of Indian soldiers during the 1962 war with China.Return to your hotel at Tawang for an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 7: Tawang to Dirang Transfer (140 km / 4.5 hrs)
itinerary.description: Have breakfast and then check out of your hotel.Now, you’ll be driven to Dirang, the journey of which will take less than 5 hours. It’s famous for having miraculous hot water springs, which are believed to cure skin ailments.Enjoy the scenic journey filled with picturesque landscapes, quaint villages, and cultural sites.Along the way, we’ll be making a stop at the TDL Monastery.Once you reach Dirang, check into your hotel and take a restful night of sleep.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 8: Transfer to Guwahati (300 km / 10 hrs)
itinerary.description: Wake up early in the morning, and drive back towards Guwahati via Kalaktang. This 10-hour drive is quite long but also scenic.Capture the beautiful picture of lush valleys and farms as you pass them.Once you reach there, check into your hotel and get a restful night of sleep.

itinerary.title: DAY 9: Transfer to Cherrapunji (150 km / 4 hrs) and Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Have breakfast in the morning.And now you’ll be taken on a sightseeing trip to Cherrapunji, the wettest place on Earth! It’s a quintessential paradise for nature lovers and explorers.Explore the natural falls, like Elephant Falls, Nohkalikai Falls, and Seven Sisters Falls. Don’t forget to capture their timeless beauty with your camera!You’ll also be taken to the following places:Mawkdok Dympep ValleyMawsmai CavesEco ParkAfter a tiring yet fulfilling sightseeing trip, return to your hotel and get some sleep.Note:Accommodations here are basic three-star hotels. Don’t expect too many modern amenities.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 10: Transfer to Mawlynnong (81 km / 2.5 hrs) – Dawki (31 km / 1.5 hrs)
itinerary.description: Take a nourishing meal in the morning. Afterwards, you’ll be taken on a tour of Meghalaya. In particular, you’ll be visiting:Mawlynnong Village– This is Asia’s cleanest village!Living Root Bridge– Get inspired by the locals’ ingenious craftsmanshipLater, we’ll be visiting Dawki, where you can enjoy a thrilling boat ride on the crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River. The river is so clear and transparent that the tourists say that they feel like flying in the air.Come back to your hotel in Shillong and enjoy an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 11: Shillong to Guwahati Transfer (100 km / 2.5 hrs) and Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty breakfast at the hotel in the morning.On this last day of your tour, the first half will be spent sightseeing. You’ll be taken to the following places:Ward's LakeShillong CathedralUmiam LakeLady Hydari ParkAfter that, you’ll be dropped off at the Guwahati airport or railway station, as per your choice. Hope you have a great trip!Note:Lady Hydari Park is closed on Mondays.Places You’ll See

After
Auli sightseeing Tour

Narasimha Temple-
It’s a part of
Sapt Badri Temple

After

After this thrilling adventure, Prepare for departure. We will drive back to Delhi. You will be transferred to the airport/ railway station for your further journey.

During the Sawan month, there will be route diversion on the highway roads like Meerut to
Haridwar

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Dehradun
itinerary.description: On reaching Dehradun you will be greeted by our tour manager. You will then be transferred to a good hotel for an overnight stay. You will also be comfortably checked in and served dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Dehradun - Kedarnath - Badrinath
itinerary.description: 6 Am - Your helicopter trip will commence early in the morning. You will be transferred to the Sahastradhara helipad from your allotted hotel early in the morning.6:45 Am - After 45 minutes of chopper ride, you will be arriving at the helipad for Kedarnath which can be Guptkashi / Phata / Sersi / Sitapur, etc. depending on the availability of the helipad.As per Government regulations, all the passengers will be transferred to a government chopper that will drop off the passengers at the Kedarnath helipad which is situated just 500 meters from the main temple.Every passenger will get to have a VIP Darshan experience. After the completion of the Darshan, all the passengers will be gathered back to the Kedarnath helipad at around 9:30 AM.9: 30 Am - After arriving at the Phata / Sersi / Sitapur helipad, you will be made to depart for the Badrinath helipad.10:00 Am - After half an hour of the flight journey you will be arriving at Badrinath helipad. You will be checked into the hotel for some relaxation and lunch. You will then be taken to Badrinath Dham Darshan along with some additional sightseeing of famous tourist places around the temple like Mana Village, Bhim Pul, etc.Shayan Aarti can be arranged on special request.Finally, after the Darshan and sightseeing experience, you will be headed back to your hotel for dinner and an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 3: Badrinath - Dehradun Departure
itinerary.description: 8:00 Am - This will be the estimated time of your departure from the Badrinath helipad to the Sahastradhara Helipad in Dehradun.9:00 Am - After 1 hour of helicopter journey, you will be arriving at the Sahastradhara helipad. On reaching the helipad you will be transferred to your departure location. The drop-off will mark the end of yourBadri Kedar Helicopter Yatra.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Delhi – Haridwar
itinerary.description: Your Do Dham Yatra will commence from the time you arrive in New Delhi. Our tour representative will transfer you into your transportation that will drop you off at your first destination in Haridwar which is also known as the 'gateway to Char Dham' since all the Char Dham Yatras begin from Rishikesh and Haridwar. This will be a road journey of around 5-6 hours as you have decided to cover Badrinath Kedarnath Yatra by Car.On arrival in Haridwar, you shall be checked into your hotel or accommodation of your choice. If you want then you can also attend the iconic Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri. You shall be staying overnight at the hotel here.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 2: Haridwar – Guptkashi
itinerary.description: After a delicious breakfast in the morning, you will be driven to your next destination of Guptkashi which is around 230 kms away from Haridwar. It will be an extremely scenic drive which will be one of the most scenic experiences of your life. You will reach there by lunch or pre-dinner time and will immediately be checked in to your hotel here for an overnight stay.If there is time for you to explore or if you are not tired much then you can even visit the famous Kashi Vishwanath Mandir here. The best option would be for you to go on a soulful leisurely walk and explore the surroundings nicely. You will be staying at your allotted hotel in Guptkashi.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 3: Guptkashi – Sonprayag – Kedarnath
itinerary.description: Early in the morning as the sun rises you shall be driven to your next destination for the day to Sonprayag. This is will be a short drive where you will be served lunch in between and will take just half an hour to 45 minutes to cover depending on the traffic.Sonprayag is a key checkpoint and registration point on the Kedarnath route. From Sonprayag, pilgrims take a shared jeep or taxi to Gaurikund (approx. 5 km) - which is the actual base camp and starting point of the 16-18 km Kedarnath trek.From here you will be able to choose to go on foot or hire some alternative method to travel like ponies or Pithu service. On reaching Kedarnath you will be staying in one of the tents or the hall accommodations here. After settling in, head to the temple for evening Darshan. Kedarnath Temple closes at approximately 8:00-9:00 PM after the evening Aarti. The post-Aarti Darshan is deeply peaceful - plan your visit accordingly.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 4: Kedarnath – Sonprayag – Rudraprayag
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, you will be taken for the morning Aarti Darshan of Baba Kedar. The spirituality of this place when paired up with the purity of the morning sun rays is one experience that you need to have as words will not do justice. After this holy Darshan of Baba Kedar, you will be your trek back to the starting point of Sonprayag will begin.Here you will meet a driver who will then transfer you to your next destination of Rudraprayag which is around 60 kms away. It is one of the holiest Panch Prayags of Uttarakhand - the sacred confluence of the Mandakini and Alaknanda rivers. From here the Alaknanda flows further downstream, eventually meeting the Bhagirathi at Devprayag to form the holy Ganga.On reaching Rudraprayag you will be transferred to your allotted choice of accommodation here for an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 5: Rudraprayag – Badrinath Dham
itinerary.description: Early in the morning after breakfast, you will be transferred to your next destination of Badrinath via a car ride. Traveling through the hills guarantees picturesque vistas during your road trip. On your way, you will be made to visit and offer Darshan at Shri Narsingh Temple which is situated in the holy town of Joshimath that lies just before Badri Vishal.After covering a distance of 158 kms and finally arriving in Badrinath you will be checked into your hotel here for an overnight stay. In the evening after freshening up or if you are in the mood to explore your surroundings you will be taken for a brief sightseeing tour of tourist attractions in Badrinath. This will include Vyas Gufa, Mana Village (3km away), Saraswati River, Bheem Pul, etc.After completing your Badrinath Yatra if you want then you can attend the evening Aarti procession at Badri Vishal Temple. Later on, you will be made to head back to your accommodation in Badrinath town for an overnight stay.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 6: Badrinath – Rudraprayag
itinerary.description: You will be made to visit the holy Badrinath temple early in the morning to attend the holy Aarti ceremony here. After the completion of your Darshan and puja rituals, you will be driven to your next destination for the day which will be Rudraprayag.After covering a scenic journey, you will be made to check in to your hotel for an overnight stay. The remainder of the day will be free for you to indulge in some leisurely activities like strolling around the holy village and relaxing amidst its scenic beauty. You shall be staying for the night in Rudraprayag.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 7: Rudraprayag – Rishikesh
itinerary.description: Your journey to Rishikesh will begin early in the morning after your breakfast. You will be driven to Rishikesh via a car journey which you will remember for a long time. You will cover a journey of around 133 kms and on arriving at Rishikesh you will be checked into your allotted hotel for an overnight stay.In the evening you will have a fun time in attending the holy Ganga Aarti at any of the ghats of Rishikesh.Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 8: Rishikesh – Delhi Departure
itinerary.description: Your journey back home will commence early in the morning from Rishikesh via the road. It will be a trip of around 5-6 hours and you will be dropped off at your departure location at the New Delhi railway station. This final drop-off will mark the end of your Do Dham pilgrimage to Kedarnath and Badrinath.

Kedarnath Trekking Guide
Read these highly useful details before you start your mountain walk:

Trek Start Point: The path starts from Gaurikund. First, ride a car to Sonprayag. Then, sit in a local jeep to reach Gaurikund gates.
Kedarnath Trek Distance: The walking road is exactly sixteen to eighteen kilometres to one side.
Altitude of Kedarnath Temple: This beautiful stone temple sits very high. Its height is around 3,583 meters above sea waters.
Kedarnath Trek Difficulty: Walking up is not very simple. The path goes high. Fit people can walk it slowly. Old people or kids must hire a horse or palanquin to go up safely.
Kedarnath Trekking Time: If walking, you need nearly six to ten hours to finish one side.
Permits Required: Yes, the government says you must carry a scanned biometric registration paper.
Facilities: You easily find horse riders calling you. Small local mountain shops sell tasty hot noodles, sweet tea, and fresh water bottles everywhere.
Trekking Route: You pass Gaurikund, Jungle Chatti, Bheembali, Linchauli, Kedarnath Base Camp, and finally Kedarnath Temple.
Safety Tips for Kedarnath Pilgrimage: Do not eat a big meal before walking. Drink lots of plain water to stop headaches. Sleep at a lower town for one day to let lungs adjust. Wear thick, strong walking shoes. Try booking very early because millions arrive here every summer. In the last year, you will see that in the first two days after opening there were 55,000 pilgrims visiting Kedarnath. nollow

Complete Badrinath Kedarnath Travel Guide
Keep these great suggestions in mind for your Kedarnath Badrinath tour package from Haridwar:

Best time for Do Dham Yatra: The greatest months to travel are May, June, September, and October. The sky looks clear during this time.
Distance between Kedarnath and Badrinath: The driving length is roughly 240 kilometres. Your car takes around ten hours to safely move between these places.
Badrinath Kedarnath Opening Dates 2026: Doors open during summer months. For 2026, temple committees will open Kedarnath around April 22 and Badrinath around April 23.
Road Conditions for Badrinath Kedarnath Yatra: Driving paths from Haridwar towards Sonprayag look fine with some mud patches. The highway towards Badrinath is built strongly. Still, stay awake near thin road corners like Joshimath and Mana village.
Kedarnath Badrinath Temple Timings: Kedarnath doors welcome visitors from 4:00 AM until 3:00 PM, and again from 5:00 PM until 9:00 PM. Badrinath gives viewing times from 4:30 AM until 1:00 PM, and 4:00 PM until 9:00 PM.
Things to pack for do Dham Yatra: Heading, How heavy winter garments including woollen coats, gentle woollens and thermals. Take warm hand gloves, caps, and muffler. Pack solid boots, plastic ID cards, travel papers, and basic cold medicine.
Hotels around Kedarnath Badrinath: Nice rooms in Guptkashi and Sitapur. Stay in very basic tent camps or lodges near Kedarnath.At Badrinath, easily pick a cheap charity room or costly hotel.
Do Dham Yatra Registration: This step is super necessary. Please fill out details on the official state website: registrationandtouristcare.uk.gov.in. nofollow
Haridwar to Kedarnath Badrinath trip cost: We offer a fair Haridwar to Kedarnath Badrinath trip cost. The starting price is normally around INR 15,400 per person.
Route Map for Badrinath Kedarnath Yatra: Following this road order is the smartest way:Haridwar → Rishikesh → Devprayag → Srinagar → Rudraprayag → Guptkashi → Sonprayag → KedarnathKedarnath → Sonprayag → Guptkashi → Joshimath → Badrinath.

itinerary.title: DAY 2: Guruvayur - Munnar (6 Hrs/180 Kms)
itinerary.description:
From Guruvayur you’ll head out on a scenic drive to Munnar, a scenic hill station.
On the way, you will appreciate the breathtaking sceneries ranging from towering mountains to spice plantations and beautiful tea gardens.
Upon arrival in Munnar, you will check-in to your pre-booked hotel.
You can spend the rest of the day as you like relaxing in your room or exploring the local attractions.

itinerary.title: DAY 3: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.description:
After a delicious breakfast you will head out for sightseeing tour of Munnar.
You will visit the famous attractions including
Mattupetty Lake & Dam
,
Echo Point
,
Kundale Lake
,
Tea Gardens
and
Rajamalai (Eravikulam National Park)
.
Mattupetty Lake & Dam:
Mattupetty Lake & Dam is one of the most beautiful attractions of Munnar with lush greenery and towering hills.
Echo Point:
Echo Point is famous for its natural beauty. Here you can listen to your voice echoing from the hills.
Rajamalai (Eravikulam National Park):
This national park is home to diverse flora and fauna.
Tea Gardens:
For nature lovers and tea enthusiasts, tea gardens are an absolute dream. You can sample freshly brewed teas over here.
Kundala Lake:
This is a man-made marvel surrounded by flowers and lush green trees. This lake is ideal for pedal boating.
Return to your hotel after the sightseeing tour and have an overnight stay.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 4: Munnar- Thekkady (03 hrs/110 Kms)
itinerary.description:
Post breakfast, you’ll head to Thekkady. On the way you'll appreciate the beautiful sceneries and splendid views.
Upon arrival at Thekkady, check-in at your hotel. Explore the
spice plantations
, which will revive your mind with the aroma of different spices.
Explore
Periyar Forest
of Thekkady, the finest wildlife reserve in India. You can also enjoy boating at
Periyar Lake
.
Head out for
spice plantation tour
and fall in love with the aromatic smell of the spices.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Thekkady.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: DAY 5: Thekkady- Alleppey. (Houseboat) (4 Hrs/140 Kms)
itinerary.description:
After breakfast you will head out on a scenic drive to Alleppey, which is also known as the Venice of the East.
Alleppey, also referred to as Alappuzha, is hailed as one of the oldest planned towns in the region. It is renowned for houseboat cruises, clear beaches, and boat races.
Option 1: Stay at Hotel
Upon arrival, you will check into the pre-reserved hotel and spend the rest of the day as you want. You can indulge in some interesting activities including:
Shopping:
Stock up on your favourite items from the local bazaars and floating markets of Alleppey. You can buy spices, paintings, artworks, and banana chips.
Sunset Cruise on Vembanadu Lake (Optional):
Witness the sunset as you enjoy a cruise on Vembanadu Lake at your own price.
Alleppey Beach:
Stroll by the shoreline of Alleppey Beach or spend a peaceful moment by the sea admiring the breathtaking views.
Option 2: Houseboat Stay
After arriving at Alleppey you can stay in a houseboat and sail along the backwater.
Houseboat Cruise:
The fanciful and strikingly beautiful houseboats transport you to a world of luxury and royalty, making it a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
You can either stay the whole night in these majestic boathouses, or you can book your stay for a few hours as per your preference.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Dehradun – Gangotri – Yamunotri
itinerary.description:
Your journey of Char Dham Yatra by helicopter commences from Dehradun. There are also options for Char Dham Yatra by helicopter by Uttarakhand government. On reaching Sahastradhara helipad at Dehradun board the helicopter to reach Harsil Helipad which is the base of Gangotri. Keep in mind that every Char Dham Yatra by helicopter starts from Dehradun. It takes almost 35 to 40 minutes to reach the destination helipad.
After reaching Harsil helipad, gorge upon the scrumptious morning meal and then head towards the sacred Gangotri Temple. Pay your offerings and homage to Goddess Ganga return back to the helipad by 11 am. Next, you will drive back to Harsil helipad to board the helicopter to visit Yamunotri. It takes almost 35 minutes to reach the destination. On reaching Yamunotri, check-into the cottages in Yamunotri and then after savoring the delectable lunch head towards the shrine. You can also opt for Palki ride and also enjoy the panoramic landscapes of the surroundings.
Upon reaching the shrine, pay homage to the goddess and seek the blessings of River Yamuna. After seeking the blessings drive towards Kharsali Village and serve yourself with mouth-watering Garhwali cuisines and then go for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.description:

As per the norms of Uttarakhand government, you will have to change the helicopter at Guptkashi and take another aircraft to reach Kedarnath which will take approx. 35 minutes more.
By 8 AM you will arrive at Kedarnath Shrine. You will have to cover a distance of 500 meters, not more than that to reach the shrine from the helipad. Pay homage at this sacred shrine and wash away all your sins and attain liberation from the cycle of birth and death. You will not have to stand in the long queue of pilgrims as you will be provided with VIP Darshan Pass in this package. After completing the puja rituals return to the helipad.
By 10 AM leave for the last pilgrimage of the journey, Badrinath Temple which is one of the most prime destinations of Vishnu worshippers. Post Darshan at Badrinath you will be transferred back to the helipad around 1 pm. Board the helicopter and reach Sahastradhara helipad in Dehradun and this is how your journey with us concludes here.

Chardham Yatra Significance
The Chardham Yatra is probably the holiest journey one can take. Considering the holiness of the sites, over 17 lakh pilgrims have registered for this holy journey in the year 2026 alone, as per ET!
The spiritually-charged tour offers nothing less than Moksha itself - the liberation from the recurring cycle of birth and death. All the Chardhams are significant in their own right and are believed to represent a different spiritual dimension.
Yamunotri (Tapa Yoga)

Yamunotri temple is dedicated to the Goddess Yamuna, who symbolises discipline, perseverance, and inner purity. The hot water springs here represent the fire of Tapasya.

Gangotri (Karma Yoga)

This sacred Gangotri Dham honors the Goddess Ganga, who is known for selfless service. This is evident when she descended to Earth to cleanse the sins of the ancestors of King Bhagirath. The whole Dham represents serving humanity selflessly through our Karma (action).

Kedarnath (Bhakti Yoga)

Kedarnath Dham is dedicated to Lord Shiva, who is known to be the destroyer of ego. It represents overcoming life's challenges through faith and devotion - Bhakti.

Badrinath (Jnana Yoga)

The Badrinath Dham is dedicated to Lord Vishnu, who represents wisdom and knowledge. The Dham signifies that one can get enlightened through self-realization and following the path of wisdom.

Helicopter seats are normally blocked at 40% advance payment and on a confirmed basis. Such payment guarantees the confirmation of seats and enables operators to work out logistics ahead of time.

All the Char Dham helicopter tours require the balance to be settled 30 days before travel, so enough time is provided to get permits and operational clearances.
7. Is the Char Dham Helicopter Tour safe for the elderly?
Yes, the helicopter Yatra is regarded as one of the safest and comforts of the older citizens and families. It saves a lot of trekking and physical stress, besides providing assisted support on the way.
8. What is the Way to Find a Reliable Helicopter Tour Operator?
A good operator normally possesses:

Strong local presence
Experience in operational years.
Effective communication and policies.
Human support rather than robotized systems.

These are the factors that facilitate a safe and well-regulated pilgrimage.
9. What follows the advance payment?
After the advance payment is done, the traveler receives a formal booking confirmation and a formal helicopter yatra voucher, which is the main travel document of the overall circuit.
10. Who Secures Booking Updates and Support?
The majority of bookings incorporate the services of a special travel consultant who updates and supports in real-time within the framework of preparation and conduction of the Char Dham Yatra, which guarantees the absence of misunderstandings on all levels of communication.
Cancellation Policy for Char Dham by Helicopter Tour
The Char Dham Yatra by helicopter is characterized by a strict cancellation policy because of a limited number of flying slots, fixed departures, and high costs of operation. All policies at My Quick Trippers are meant to ensure transparency and control the aviation and ground logistics.
In case the Passenger Makes a Cancelation
Over 30 days before departure:
There will be a cancellation fee of 40% of the total tour cost.

Within 30 days of departure:
100% cancellation charges apply. No refund will be issued.

Rescheduling (7 days or more before traveling):
Allowed with a 10% rebooking charge, on the condition of seat and flight availability.

Rescheduling within 7 days:
Treated as a cancellation. A new reservation will be necessary.

In the case of Cancellation or Delay by Weather or Force Majeure

Hotels, meals, and local transport will not be refunded because of weather delays.
In the case of unvisited Dhams, 25% of the cost of the tour per Dham as missed is refundable, subject to 15,000 per head of fixed preparation costs and ground handling costs.
In case the tour is not started at Dehradun because of the weather conditions or due to the limitations imposed by ATC, a full refund will be given.
In case any site is missed during the tour and the itinerary is changed in the remaining days, no refund would be made.
Ferries or rescue flights made as an emergency will cost 90000 rupees per hour + GST, which will be paid directly.

Important Additional Terms

Overweight fees (2500 per kg) and fines for wrong declaration of weight (20,000) are non-refundable.
Accommodation in Kedarnath is not refundable in case of guests being stranded by adverse weather.
The absence of no-shows or lateness to the helipad will lead to the total cancellation without refunds.
In case the tour is canceled halfway through the journey on request of the guest, transportation back to Dehradun will be done at a separate cost.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Arrival in Dehradun
itinerary.description: One the first day of your Chardham Yatra by Helicopter, you will be arriving at Dehradun and greeted by our tour representative. You will be transferred to your allotted here for an overnight complimentary stay in Dehradun. You shall be staying the night here.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Dehradun - Yamunotri
itinerary.description:
This day will mark the official commencement of your helicopter Char Dham Yatra. You will be checked out of the hotel and dropped off at the Sahastradhara Helipad of Dehradun which is also the starting point of this holy journey.
You will be flown to the first destination of Kharsali Helipad which is located near Yamunotri Temple. On arriving in Kharsali you will further be transferred to the starting point of the 7 km long trek to this easternmost temple.
This 7 km long route can easily be covered on a pony or a Palki ride with ease. After completing your VIP Darshan, you will be taken back to Kharsali.
You will be checked in to your hotel here for an overnight stay. The remainder of the day will be free for you to relax in the hotel.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 3: Yamunotri - Gangotri
itinerary.description:
Your journey to Gangotri by helicopter will begin early in the morning the next day after breakfast. After a helicopter ride of around 45 minutes, you will be dropped off at Harsil Helipad which is the nearest and the only Helipad for Gangotri Dham temple.
On reaching Harsil you will be taken to the temple of Gangotri via a cab ride which will take around one hour.
By afternoon your VIP holy Darshan of Gangotri Temple will be completed and you will be taken to your allotted hotel in Harsil for an overnight stay. After Darshan, the remainder of the day will be free for you to relax and spend time in leisure amidst the grand Himalayan beauty.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 4: Gangotri - Kedarnath
itinerary.description:
Your trip to Kedarnath will begin early in the morning after breakfast. It will be a journey of around 45 minutes from Harsil Helipad to the Helipad for Kedarnath which can be Guptkashi, Sersi, Sitapur or Phata.
As per the directions of Uttarakhand government in order to preserve the untouched beauty of the Kedarnath Himalayas, you will be transferred into a government chopper which has the permit to get you to Kedarnath Temple directly.
Surpassing the 18 km long uphill trek you will be taken to Kedarnath Helipad within 10 minutes and is located just 500 metres away from the main temple entrance.
You will be given 1.5 hours to complete your Darshan in Kedarnath before heading back to the helipad. From here on you will be taken back to your hotel near Kedarnath for an overnight stay.
You can plan some sightseeing around Kedarnath as well during this time.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 5: Kedarnath - Badrinath
itinerary.description:
After having your breakfast early in the morning your journey to your next destination of Badrinath Dham will begin. This will be a chopper ride of around 45 minutes to half an hour. You shall be landed in the helipad near Badrinath which is just around 1 km away from the main temple entrance. A cab will be arranged for you to transfer you from the helipad to the temple.
After offering your puja Darshan and prayers at the iconic Badri Vishal, you will also have the option of taking a sightseeing trip to the nearby tourist attraction of Mana Village, Bhim Pul, Vasudhara Waterfall or whatever you like.
After the completion of your Darshan and sightseeing of Badrinath Dham you will be taken back to your hotel near the temple for an overnight stay.
Places You’ll See

itinerary.title: Day 6: Badrinath - Dehradun
itinerary.description:
After the special Abhishek Puja in Badrinath Dham Temple, you will be taken for another Darshan of Badri Vishal. Finally, after the completion of your puja rituals in Badrinath, you will be headed to the Badrinath Helipad.
Finally, your Char Dham Yatra by Helicopter will come to an end with your drop-off in Sahastradhara Helipad where the journey had kickstarted. Upon your drop off in Dehradun Helipad, you will be free to go to your desired destination.

Yatra Registration — What Pilgrims from Kolkata Must Know

Mandatory since 2023 — No registration, no entry at checkposts (Janki Chatti, Gangotri entry, Sonprayag, Pandukeshwar)
Official portal: registrationandtouristcare.uk.gov.in (Government of Uttarakhand)
Documents required: Aadhaar Card (mandatory), one passport-size photograph, medical fitness self-declaration (age 60+ require a doctor's certificate dated within 30 days of departure)
Biometric camps: Available at Haridwar, Rishikesh, Sonprayag, and at each dham
Our process: Our team completes online pre-registration before your departure from Kolkata. Biometric fingerprint verification at Haridwar camp takes under 15 minutes with our coordinator present.

VIP / Vishesh Darshan Pass

Available at Kedarnath and Badrinath — approximately ₹300–₹500 per person
Reduces general queue time from 3–5 hours to 45–90 minutes at Kedarnath during peak season

Yamunotri and Gangotri do not have a formal VIP system — queue management is by temple priests on the day

Photography Rules
Photography is prohibited inside the sanctum sanctorum at all four dhams. Outer courtyards, ghats, and river areas permit photography freely. CCTV cameras are present inside all four temples — violations result in confiscation of devices.

How To Reach
By Air
The nearest airport to the Chardham circuit is Jolly Grant Airport, Dehradun (IATA: DED) — approximately 35 km from Haridwar. From Kolkata (Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, CCU), no direct flights operate to Dehradun; all routes connect via Delhi. Total travel time Kolkata–Dehradun via Delhi is approximately 4–5 hours including layover. IndiGo and Air India operate this route. A second option: fly Kolkata–Delhi (2 hours), and our team transfers you directly to Haridwar by road (5–6 hours).
Kedarnath Helicopter: Operated from Phata, Sirsi, and Agustmuni helipads (25–40 km from Guptkashi). Booking must be done through the official IRCTC helicopter booking portal (heliyatra.irctc.co.in) or the Uttarakhand Tourism (UTT) portal — never through private agents. One-way fare is approximately ₹4,500–₹6,000 per person (subject to annual revision). Helicopter tickets are not included in any package tier and must be booked separately well in advance.
By Train
The most common route for Kolkata pilgrims is Howrah to Delhi on the Howrah–New Delhi Rajdhani Express (Train No. 12301/12302) — approximately 17 hours, arriving New Delhi Station. From Delhi, our vehicle drives to Haridwar (230 km / 5–6 hours). An alternative is to take any train to Haridwar Junction directly — several trains from Howrah connect to Haridwar in 22–24 hours. Our team coordinates pickup at either New Delhi Station or Haridwar Junction.
By Road
Kolkata to Haridwar is approximately 1,600 km by road — not recommended for the full journey due to distance. The practical approach is train or flight to Delhi or Dehradun, after which all travel is by our private vehicle. Our ground tour starts from Delhi — the Kolkata–Delhi leg is booked independently.
